About Binary Defense
Industry Specialties
Solving complex problems
across all industries
01
Manufacturing
We help manufacturers stay ahead of threats that target production lines, remote facilities, and proprietary designs to keep operations secure and on schedule.
02
Retail
Cybercriminals exploit brand reputation and complex digital storefronts. We defend against fraud, account abuse, and impersonation so trust never takes a hit
03
Healthcare
From ransomware to insider risk, attackers test every system that enables care. We help you respond quickly and quietly, so clinical workflows and patient safety stay intact.
04
Finance
With constant pressure from attackers and regulators, financial firms need more than detection. We bring real-time visibility, threat expertise, and fast response to protect what matters most.
05
Energy & Utilities
Energy operations can’t afford downtime. We help secure both IT and OT environments with detection strategies built for complex, high-stakes infrastructure.
06
Education
Academic environments face mounting cyber risk. We help secure students, staff, and research from phishing, ransomware, and account compromise, without slowing education down.
